routes.result: default-off NO_EFFECT P110 DOMAIN_COMMITTED receipt plus exact authoritative readback; immutable selection requires signed same-tenant human authority and atomically appends approved Bid Comparison v2
SeedProcurementReadModel/v2 inside apiResponse({ok,result,...}) with exact correction and supplier producer pins

admitted_local_behavior: Evidence Artifact, Product Source, Product Candidate, RFQ draft, normalized Supplier Quote, Bid Comparison and immutable human Procurement Selection are API-owned append-only canonical writes.
Product Source records exact direct Evidence Artifact lineage and optional ordered upstream Evidence Artifact lineage; URL-resolved PDF therefore keeps both artifacts.
Candidate vendor, RFQ supplier, normalized quote, bid set and selection require exact current SupplierProfile/v1 version and capability readback.
Bid recommendations remain non-authoritative; only a signed same-tenant human selection creates approved Bid Comparison v2.
Every admitted mutation is atomic with one owner row, P110 receipt, event and NO_EFFECT outbox; the derived approved bid receives a separate causally linked receipt.
Readback reconstructs and validates exact tenant, Project, source, supplier, version, receipt, economics and authority lineage.

remaining_dependency_holds.dependency: SEED-PROPOSAL-OWNER-A2P ProposalVersion/v1 canonical persistence and exact readback

consumer_rules: Pin command/read-model version, correction producer SHA, supplier-identity producer SHA and exact candidate SHA independently.
Do not accept SeedProcurementCommand/v1 or SeedProcurementReadModel/v1; retain the published v1 fixture only as a known-bad control.
Do not create local canonical RFQ, quote, bid, selection or purchase-order writers.
Do not display a recommendation as a human selection or provider acknowledgement as source-confirmed completion.
Keep Proposal and PO flows visibly blocked until A2P exact owner/readback evidence is admitted.
No consumer may infer product fetching, vendor-email ingestion, RFQ send, PO release, supplier commitment, managed migration, deployment or any external effect from this G0 handoff.
